[[File:Golden_Globe_Awards_signs.jpg | thumb | right | Signs for the Golden Globe Awards.]]
The '''14th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1956 in film|1956]] films, were held on February 28, 1957, at the Cocoanut Grove, [[Ambassador Hotel (Los Angeles)]].

==Winners and Nominees==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Motion Picture - Drama]]===
'''''[[Around the World in 80 Days (1956 film)|Around the World in 80 Days]]''''' directed by '''[[Michael Anderson (director)|Michael Anderson]]'''
* ''[[Giant (1956 film)|Giant]]'' directed by [[George Stevens]]
* ''[[Lust for Life (1956 film)|Lust for Life]]'' directed by [[Vincente Minnelli]]
* ''[[The Rainmaker (1956 film)|The Rainmaker]]'' directed by [[Joseph Anthony]]
* ''[[War and Peace (1956 film)|War and Peace]]'' directed by [[King Vidor]]

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Motion Picture - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' ''[[The King and I (1956 film)|The King and I]]'' directed by [[Walter Lang]]'''
*''[[Bus Stop (1956 film)|Bus Stop]]'' directed by [[Joshua Logan]]
*''[[The Opposite Sex]]'' directed by [[David Miller (director)|David Miller]]
*''[[The Solid Gold Cadillac]]'' directed by [[Richard Quine]]
*''[[The Teahouse of the August Moon (film)|The Teahouse of the August Moon]]'' directed by [[Daniel Mann]]<ref>"Best Picture (Previous Award Given)" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1956 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120309030948/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1956 |date=2012-03-09 }}</ref>

'''[[Kirk Douglas]] - ''[[Lust for Life (1956 film)|Lust for Life]]'''''
*[[Gary Cooper]] - ''[[Friendly Persuasion (1956 film)|Friendly Persuasion]]''
*[[Charlton Heston]] - ''[[The Ten Commandments (1956 film)|The Ten Commandments]]''
*[[Burt Lancaster]] - ''[[The Rainmaker (1956 film)|The Rainmaker]]''
*[[Karl Malden]] -  ''[[Baby Doll]]''<ref>"Best Performance by an Actor in a Leading Role" http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1956 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120309030948/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1956 |date=2012-03-09 }}</ref>
